- const downloadFileContent = async () =&gt; {};
+ const downloadFileContent = async () =&gt; {
+ 	const batchSize = 20;
+ 	const totalFiles = ids.length;
+ 	const batchCount = Math.ceil(totalFiles / batchSize);
+ 
+ 	console.log(
+ 		&#96;Processing ${totalFiles} files in ${batchCount} batches of ${batchSize}&#96;,
+ 	);
+ 
+ 	for (let i = 0; i &lt; batchCount; i++) {
+ 		const startIdx = i * batchSize;
+ 		const endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + batchSize, totalFiles);
+ 		const batch = ids.slice(startIdx, endIdx);
+ 
+ 		console.log(
+ 			&#96;Processing batch ${i + 1}/${batchCount}, files ${startIdx + 1}-${endIdx}&#96;,
+ 		);
+ 
+ 		const promises = batch.map(async (fileId) =&gt; {
+ 			try {
+ 				const curlCommand = await curlFileContent(fileId);
+ 				// Execute the curl command
+ 				const { exec } = require("child_process");
+ 
+ 				return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {
+ 					exec(curlCommand, (error: any, stdout: string, stderr: string) =&gt; {
+ 						if (error) {
+ 							console.error(
+ 								&#96;Error processing file ${fileId}: ${error.message}&#96;,
+ 							);
+ 							reject(error);
+ 							return;
+ 						}
+ 						if (stderr) {
+ 							console.warn(&#96;Warning for file ${fileId}: ${stderr}&#96;);
+ 						}
+ 						console.log(&#96;Successfully processed file ${fileId}&#96;);
+ 						resolve(stdout);
+ 					});
+ 				});
+ 			} catch (error) {
+ 				console.error(&#96;Failed to process file ${fileId}: ${error}&#96;);
+ 				throw error;
+ 			}
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		try {
+ 			// Wait for all promises in the current batch to complete
+ 			await Promise.all(promises);
+ 			console.log(&#96;Completed batch ${i + 1}/${batchCount}&#96;);
+ 		} catch (error) {
+ 			console.error(&#96;Error in batch ${i + 1}: ${error}&#96;);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Optional: Add a small delay between batches to avoid overwhelming the API
+ 		if (i &lt; batchCount - 1) {
+ 			await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	console.log("All batches processed successfully");
+ };
+
